summary: P02 can proceed as a bounded source-to-case implementation. Current retained-file hashes match the Apple manifest, and independent heading scans confirm 13 annual and 10 interim notes. The existing builder hard-codes selected statement/debt amounts, while interim Note 9 retains a generic unresolved disposition. P01’s accepted source register is in its run directory. Reuse the prior planning log’s verified findings and implement a new versioned module without rewriting preserved evidence. This plan addresses MC01, MC03, MC05, MC16 and MC28 without closing the wider gaps.
steps: 1. Establish the input and write boundaries. Read the accepted P01 register, Apple originals, extracted text, manifest and retained SEC submissions index. Recheck hashes and bind each original to its extraction and document identity. Create scripts/apple_case_v1.py and tests/test_accounting_p02.py. Write only case.json and result.md under data/accounting-master/deliverables/P02. Any newly acquired sources go into a new docs/design/cases/apple/p02-v1/ directory. Preserve existing builders, manifests, snapshots, benchmark files and controller files.

2. Implement reusable source-anchor and extraction functions. Annual anchors must include original/extraction hashes, PDF page, printed page where identifiable, exact text offsets and quotation; retain table headers and selected column locations. Interim extraction must resolve inline-XBRL fact, context and unit IDs from the retained HTML, including entity, instant/duration, dimensions, currency, scale, sign, decimals and supported transformation. Validate extracted values against rendered labels/text. Reject missing, ambiguous or unsupported interpretations rather than guessing. Keep source readings, annotations and derived results separate.

3. Build the 23-note disposition layer from actual source spans. Independently discover note boundaries, reconcile them with the inventory and exclude following auditor/MD&A sections. Give every note explicit linked quantities or a specific unresolved meaning, affected model areas, qualifications and cross-reference targets. Replace the generic interim Contingencies treatment with an anchored management assertion whose uncertainty is preserved without inventing a probability or zero liability. Record annual/interim policy differences from their own passages. Report inventory, numerical coverage and semantic coverage separately.

4. Implement context validation and exact reconciliation using Fraction or Decimal, with no binary-float tolerance. Select facts by concept, reporting date/period, entity, perimeter, dimensions, measurement basis and unit. Check annual/comparative/interim balance-sheet identities; annual principal-to-carrying and current/noncurrent debt bridges; interim statement debt against rounded narrative debt; annual and interim product/segment revenue totals separately against statement revenue; annual PP&E gross-to-net; and annual/interim cash-flow opening-plus-movements-to-closing balances. Preserve each operand’s source and explain every permitted context transformation.

5. Implement rounding-aware comparisons. Retain displayed values and precision separately from inferred intervals. Encode 97,341 − 321 − 358 = 96,662 and 10,912 + 85,750 = 96,662 as displayed annual debt identities, and 10,848 + 83,956 = 94,804 as the interim identity. Verify 94,804 million is compatible with the displayed 94.8 billion under an explicitly recorded rounding model. Distinguish carrying amount, principal, fair value and derivative notional. For rounded aggregates, propagate operand intervals exactly; never conceal mismatches with a broad epsilon.

6. Preserve unidentified histories explicitly. Link the disclosed fixed-rate debt, swap discussion and annual 14,575 million interest-rate notional while leaving contract allocation, reset dates, hedge coverage, interim exposure, asset cohorts and contingent outcomes unresolved where unsupported. Retain the existing financing stress only as a labelled conditional illustration, if included; do not promote its assumed exposure or zero-tax treatment into extracted facts. Do not manufacture a debt roll-forward from cash movements when FX, noncash and measurement movements remain unidentified.

7. Investigate incorporation and publication obligations. Enumerate exact annual Part III and exhibit-index targets, distinguish material already inside the retained PDF from external documents, and preserve internal-reference closure separately. Use the retained SEC index to identify the 2025 proxy accession 0001308179-25-000008 and the annual/interim filing identities. Inspect legitimate SEC or issuer sources for the proxy and financing agreements relevant to this slice. Preserve acquired bytes, hashes, retrieval times and exact supporting spans. Give remaining obligations their target document/exhibit, version, missing terms, consequence and next legitimate retrieval route. Keep mirror availability distinct from filing availability; a selected-table match does not establish whole-PDF publication equivalence.

8. Generate deterministic case.json containing source bindings, typed observations, all note dispositions, mappings, bridges, external obligations, availability records and unidentified-history records. Provide build and read-only --check CLI modes. result.md must record the pre-run evidence/default audit, actual commands, deterministic check results, changed-file hashes, environment, elapsed time, input/output paths, decision table and separate implementation/accounting/forecast/human-acceptance assessments. Use the reviewed phase packet as plan provenance; report unavailable Git provenance honestly.
assumptions: The case scope is Apple’s fiscal 2024 annual report and fiscal 2025 first-quarter report, retaining their disclosed comparatives. Apple’s fiscal calendar must come from the filings; calendar-year or generic 90-day substitutions are not permitted.
The existing manifest is an inventory and regression reference, not the numerical oracle. The accepted P01 register supplies provenance; the retained source passages supply the actual values.

The current core_semantics.py validator explicitly supports a frozen synthetic source. P02 therefore adds a separate bounded case module rather than claiming the existing validator accepts real filings.

Use standard-library arithmetic/parsing or already-installed dependencies. PDF text extraction uses the existing pdftotext capability. Missing capabilities receive one explicit residual and no installation, approval request or bypass.

Where the source establishes presentation precision but not tie-breaking, nearest-rounding intervals are a documented interpretation with conservative endpoints, not a proved issuer rule. Unsupported precision remains unresolved.

No scientific experiment, tuning comparison or forecasting run is required. Verification concerns deterministic extraction and arithmetic, so statistical superiority and a baseline performance ladder are inapplicable.
checks: Skeptical audit: the plan replaces authored totals as truth with source-bound readings; guards against scale, sign, measurement and cash-perimeter mismatches; separates filing, retrieval and mirror availability; and uses deterministic rejection tests rather than semantic-coverage counts as promotion evidence. It avoids GPU/environment dependencies and contains no stochastic ranking.

Pre-run evidence contract: pass requires all 23 anchored note dispositions, successful supported bridges and expected adversarial rejections. Missing mandatory inputs, hash failures, ambiguous required extraction, unsupported context or failed arithmetic veto acceptance and trigger repair. External-access failure blocks only the unsupported incorporation/version claim; it must not erase independent completed work.

Run python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_accounting_p02.py -v. Tests must consume the real retained annual text/PDF and interim HTML, verify selected annual rows through independent pdftotext output, and use independently stated arithmetic expectations rather than importing expected results from the builder.

Test missing/duplicate notes, incorrect note boundaries, altered quotations and source hashes, broken fact/context/unit IDs, wrong scale/sign/currency/entity/perimeter/date, dimensional duplicates and conflicting repeated readings. Mutating supplied case metadata while leaving source bytes unchanged must fail revalidation.

Check the annual cash-flow opening balance of 30,737 against its own source perimeter; substituting balance-sheet cash of 29,965 must fail. Check product and geography partitions separately; combining both totals must fail. Reject substitution of fair value or derivative notional for debt carrying value.

Test compatible and incompatible rounded debt values, exact interval endpoints, unknown availability, later proxy evidence at earlier cutoffs and separately retained conflicting versions. No unknown publication timestamp may become a fabricated point timestamp.

Run python3 -B scripts/apple_case_v1.py --output-dir data/accounting-master/deliverables/P02, then python3 -B scripts/apple_case_v1.py --check --output-dir data/accounting-master/deliverables/P02. Require deterministic substantive output, valid source links and a report that preserves unresolved obligations.

Compare pre/post hashes of touched inputs and protected files; record every newly created source/code/test file. Run no controller, acquisition sweep, GPU diagnostic, background process or model worker.
residuals: The prior attempt timed out before returning a plan. Its inspected findings have been reused and key input hashes/counts checked; this attempt performed no implementation or experiment.
Neither P02 deliverable nor its required test file currently exists. All implementation steps and proposed checks remain unexecuted.
Complete external-package closure, historical availability of the mirrored annual PDF and detailed contract histories remain unresolved until supported by retained evidence.

Note dispositions and reconciliation tests cannot establish complete accounting semantics, accounting compliance, full-company reconstruction, empirical forecast validity or human acceptance. G1–G18 retain their wider obligations.
next_actions: Review this bounded plan against P02’s criteria, then assign the implementation role to create the versioned module, required tests and two declared deliverables.
Implement source binding and independent arithmetic checks first; complete the note and external-obligation records before evaluating phase acceptance.
Review actual code, source passages, generated case and rejection-test evidence before accepting the implementation.
